data.input_mode: Input mode: long (default), wide_matrix (features x cells), or wide_cells (cells x features).
data.cell_id_column: Column name for cell/sample id (long mode) or cell id in annotation (wide modes).
data.feature_column: Feature/gene column name in long mode, or feature id column in wide_matrix mode.
data.value_column: Numeric value column name in long mode.
data.group_column: REQUIRED. Column name for the facet/group variable.
data.annotation_column: Optional column used for the annotation strip (add_anno).

plot_mode.add_stat: Overlay statistic: boxplot, median, or none.
plot_mode.add_anno: Add annotation tile strip below the main plot (patchwork).

labels.title: Plot title.
labels.xlab: X axis title (hidden by default, SCA style).
labels.y_anno_label: Label for the annotation strip y axis (plot.y.anno in original).

typography.x_axis_text_angle: X tick label angle (default 45, SCA style).

colors.group_colors: Named vector of colors for violin fills (per feature/group).
colors.point_size: Default point size (psize in original, default 0.5).
colors.anno_colors: Named vector of colors for the annotation strip tiles.

layers.rotate_x: Force x axis text to 90 degrees (overrides x_axis_text_angle).

annotations.add_anno: Add annotation tile strip below the main plot.
annotations.annotation_column: Column used to build the annotation strip.
annotations.y_anno_label: Y axis label for the annotation strip.
annotations.anno_colors: Named colors for the annotation strip tiles.

legends.legend_show: Show/hide legend (default FALSE, matching SCA legend.position='none').
legends.legend_position: Legend position: right, left, bottom, top, or none.

selectors.highlight_features: Features to highlight (reserved for future use).
selectors.highlight_color: Color for highlighted features (reserved for future use).
